Should the German market leader be worried about this all-new Polestar?!

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Meet the all-new Polestar 5! 

It’s an all-electric performance GT that has class leaders like the Audi e-tron GT & Porsche Taycan in its sights! 

The question is, does the Polestar offer enough to steer you away from the more established, best-in-class models that Germany has to offer? Let’s take a closer look… 

In terms of the design, there’s no denying it has some real presence on the road. Up front, it comes with split headlight elements that really help it look menacing. You’ll find some fake vents at the front, although there’s a large vent across the bottom of the bumper that can close when the battery doesn’t need cooling. The safety sensors have also been well hidden, to further improve the looks. Along the side, there are contours on the doors to add more definition, coupled with frameless windows.
